title: The Most Dangerous Game
subtitle: The Most Dangerous Game
author: Richard Connell
short_description: A big-game hunter is shipwrecked on an island where a Russian general hunts humans for sport.
description: Rainsford falls off a yacht and swims to Ship Trap Island, where General Zaroff hunts shipwrecked men as the only quarry worthy of his skill. Rainsford must survive three days in the jungle. The most widely anthologised thriller in American literature.
